definitions.explanation: The act of separating a person or thing from others. Used in medical contexts for quarantine, and more broadly for any forced separation or segregation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染者|かんせんしゃ}→感染者：28388_kansensha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隔離|かくり}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{隔離|かくり}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五日間|いつかかん}だった。
examples.english: The quarantine period was five days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧{接触者|せっしょくしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{隔離|かくり}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To prevent the spread of the new virus, close contacts were quarantined at home.

notes:
Compound of {隔|かく} (to separate/partition) + {離|り} (to detach/distance). Carries a clinical or official tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔離|かくり}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to isolate; to quarantine)
- {隔離|かくり}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (quarantine period)
- {隔離|かくり}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ (quarantine facility)
- {隔離|かくり}⟦{病棟|びょうとう}→病棟：21002_byoutou⟧ (isolation ward)
- ⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧{隔離|かくり} (home quarantine)

USAGE:
Became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic. Also used historically for the forced segregation of people with diseases such as Hansen's disease (leprosy).
